limitations: Synthetic paused Chromium native touch emulation with software WebGL.
Each capture releases contacts and pauses; frequent observation boundaries shorten waits. No human reaction-time or causal game-quality benefit inferred.
Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance and continuous enjoyment unassessed.
Automatic approximately 3-second live / 1.2-second FIRE boundaries inspected each time; requested waits often shortened. No boundary bypass, no blind capture loops.

Assisted route completion alone is not evidence of manual control quality; manual patrol coverage is documented separately.
No recovered-memory reading or audio assessed; enjoyment of that content not inferred.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed but functional; 7 good with meaningful friction; 10 exceptional and consistently effortless in assessed scope. Subjective holistic scores, not win-based grades or physical-device certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent complete short mission with actionable feedback and approachable assists; portrait target size and HUD competition impose friction. Both clears were substantially assisted and frequently paused.
reasons.controls: Two-contact movement and FIRE drag and scene swipes produced visible expected responses; tap aim helped. Side target identity was uncertain and free aim / continuous hold comfort remain partial.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil vulnerability and uplink provide distinct understandable phases. Assisted path use dominated travel; threat avoidance, alternative strategies and sustained challenge were not deeply sampled.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber industrial rain scene, clear gun animation and polished title/result cards. Audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual hold, progress bars, named map and explicit fresh start support completion. Route-facing wall and simultaneous messages weaken orientation.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and major objectives stand out, but small condensed labels, distant enemies and layered feedback demand close reading at 390px.
